title: GPS coordinates not being captured in Inviso location fields on iOS devices
description: The location field in the site inspection form is not capturing GPS data on iOS devices. The field shows 'Location unavailable' when tapped. Android devices with the same app version capture GPS correctly. This started after updating to iOS 17.

worklogs.description: Researched iOS 17 location permission changes. iOS 17 introduced new 'Ask Every Time' location permission mode that overrides permanent grants.
Confirmed with the customer: iOS 17 reset location permissions for all apps. Inviso needs 'While Using App' or 'Always' permission to capture GPS.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Hello, I investigated the GPS issue on iOS 17. Apple changed how location permissions work in iOS 17 - when users upgrade, the system can reset app location permissions or add the new 'Ask Every Time' option. When 'Ask Every Time' is selected, each GPS capture requires an explicit approval prompt, and if users dismiss it, the location is unavailable. I believe this is what happened after the iOS 17 update. Could you ask one of the affected users to go to iPhone Settings > Privacy > Location...

comments.author: customer
comments.message: I checked with Ahmet on the field team. His iPhone shows 'Ask Every Time' for Inviso. He thought he had allowed it permanently before.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: That is the cause. iOS 17 added 'Ask Every Time' as a new option and may have defaulted some apps to it during the upgrade. Inviso needs 'While Using App' permission for GPS to work reliably during form completion. Ask all iOS 17 users to change the Inviso location permission from 'Ask Every Time' to 'While Using App' in iPhone Settings > Privacy > Location Services > Inviso. After this change, GPS captures will work without any additional prompts.

comments.author: customer
comments.message: I sent the instructions to all 8 iOS users. They confirmed GPS is now working on their devices. Should we update the Inviso onboarding documentation?

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Yes, I recommend adding a note to the Inviso onboarding and upgrade documentation about iOS location permission requirements. Also worth mentioning in any future iOS major version upgrade communications. I am closing this ticket as resolved.

resolutionNote: iOS 17 changed location permission handling and reset Inviso's location permission to 'Ask Every Time' on upgraded devices. All 8 affected iOS users updated Inviso location permission to 'While Using App'. GPS capture working normally.

csat.comment: Fast diagnosis. Clear instructions that worked first time.
